rows.label: tlk43700241_04_msg0001
rows.name:
It's best if you switch around your
Assist Cores to best suit your Blades
and the enemies you're up against.

rows.label: tlk43700241_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Like if you're up against
enemies that only appear at
night, equip Night Vision.

rows.label: tlk43700241_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Or if you move around a lot to
get into better positions,
Movement Heal is what you want.

rows.label: tlk43700241_04_msg0004
rows.name:
Planning for another fight with
Heaven's Holy Grail taught me a lot
about Assist Cores.

rows.label: tlk43700241_04_msg0005
rows.name:
I know so much about Assist
Cores now, I've even got friends
coming to me for advice.

rows.label: tlk43700241_04_msg0006
rows.name:
I'm surprised I can work this hard
myself.

rows.label: tlk43700241_04_msg0007
rows.name:
Guess I have to thank Heaven's
Holy Grail for that too!
